create.lede: Paste a password, token, or any sensitive string — or attach a file. We encrypt everything in your browser and hand back a single-use link. The decryption key never touches our servers — it lives after the # in the URL.
create.placeholder:
# Paste your secret here

API_KEY=sk_live_••••••••••••••••
DB_PASSWORD=••••••••••

Plain text, JSON, .env — anything works.
create.info: Your secret is encrypted in this browser before it leaves. The decryption key is appended after the # in the link — fragments are never sent to our servers.
create.f1b: We never see your plaintext. Encryption happens in your browser using WebCrypto.
create.f2b: Secret is wiped from our database the moment it's read — or when it expires.
create.f3b: Audit the code, run your own instance, or pin to a specific commit.

generated.title: Your link is ready.
generated.lede: Send this URL to the recipient over any channel. The decryption key lives in the fragment — we can't read it, log it, or recover it. Once read, the secret is gone forever.
generated.shareNativeText: An encrypted one-time link from burnotes. Open it to reveal — it disappears once read.
generated.warnBody: Anyone who opens this link will burn it. Don't preview it yourself, and warn link previewers (Slack/iMessage) that auto-expand URLs may consume the secret.
generated.qrSubtitle: Anyone with this code can open the secret. Treat it like the link itself.

reveal.title: Someone sent you a one-time message.
reveal.titleMulti: Someone sent you an encrypted message.
reveal.lede: You can open it only once. After that the message is gone forever — copy or memorize what you need before you close the tab.
reveal.ledeMulti: You can open this message {count, plural, one {# more time} other {# more times}}. After that it's gone forever — copy what you need while you still can.
reveal.ledeUnlimited: This link can be opened as many times as you need, until it expires. Once the timer runs out, the message is gone.
reveal.linkValidDays: {count, plural, one {link is good for # more day} other {link is good for # more days}}
reveal.linkValidHours: {count, plural, one {link is good for # more hour} other {link is good for # more hours}}
reveal.linkValidMinutes: {count, plural, one {link is good for # more minute} other {link is good for # more minutes}}
reveal.linkValidSeconds: {count, plural, one {# second left} other {# seconds left}}
reveal.lockedSub: The message is encrypted — we can't see what's inside. Only this link can decrypt it.
reveal.revealHint: deleted forever once you read it
reveal.revealHintRemaining: {count, plural, one {# more read available after this} other {# more reads available after this}}
reveal.info: By revealing, you confirm you're ready to read this now. We will delete the encrypted payload from our database immediately after — there is no undo. If you suspect this link was intercepted, close this tab and ask the sender to issue a new one.
reveal.readsRemaining: {count, plural, one {# read remaining} other {# reads remaining}}
reveal.passwordPromptSub: This secret is locked with a passphrase. Enter it to unlock and burn.
reveal.passwordPromptHint: Minimum {min, number} characters. After five wrong attempts the secret is destroyed.
reveal.passwordWrong: Wrong passphrase. The secret is destroyed after five misses.
reveal.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts from this network. Wait a minute and try again.
reveal.errorServiceUnavailable: Server is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
reveal.errorNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

revealed.lede: The encrypted payload has been deleted from our servers. This page is the only place this secret exists right now — copy it into your password manager or wherever it belongs before closing the tab.
revealed.burnedBody: The encrypted payload has been wiped from our database. Reloading this page will not bring it back.
revealed.multiReadBody: {count, plural, one {# more read remains before this secret burns.} other {# more reads remain before this secret burns.}}
revealed.multiReadBodyUnlimited: This link has unlimited reads until it expires.

burned.lede: The link you opened has either been read once already, or the expiration window has closed. We don't keep copies, so we can't recover it for you — please ask the sender to issue a new link.
burned.heading: Nothing to see here
burned.body: Either someone read this before you, or the expiration timer ran out. The encrypted blob has been permanently removed from our database.
